# RelUX by KAI — Design System KAI v1

> Dokumentasi bilingual (ID/EN) untuk Make Kit `@make-kits/design-system-kai-v-1@0.0.2`.
> Bilingual ID/EN documentation for Make Kit `@make-kits/design-system-kai-v-1@0.0.2`.

## Foundations / Fondasi

- Logo
- Colors / Warna — generated canonical token catalog
- Typography / Tipografi — 54 Make Kit classes
- Spacing & Grid
- Radius, Effects & Shadow
- Iconography / Ikonografi
- Component States / State komponen

## Components / Komponen

- Button
- Form Controls
- Badges & Tags
- Alert & Banner
- Cards
- Data Table
- Navigation
- Modal & Dialog
- Avatars
- Progress
- App UI Components

## RelUX extensions

- Accordion
- Interactive state reference

## Examples / Contoh

- KAI Operations Dashboard / Dashboard Operasi KAI
- KAI Landing Page
- Google Authenticator Guide for ESA Web and ESA Mobile

## Code

Every component group includes React and executable HTML + CSS examples. Interactive
HTML examples also include JavaScript. All authored styling resolves to CSS variables
from the Make Kit; Inter is the only UI font.
